scenes.title: Four Travelers Meet in Karawa
scenes.rationale: The separate arrivals flow directly into the shared hyena fight that brings the four travelers together.

scenes.title: Aftermath and Introductions
scenes.rationale: The immediate aftermath, examination of the hyenas, and introductions form one continuous teahouse scene.

scenes.title: Karawa Asks for Help
scenes.rationale: Kisa and Candrosa arrive and shift the situation from introductions to a formal request for investigation.

scenes.title: Into the Badlands
scenes.rationale: The party forms, prepares, follows the trail, and enters the desert in one continuous outbound journey.

scenes.title: The Road to Gomat
scenes.rationale: Alesh redirects the investigation toward Gomat, and the ensuing road journey ends with the discovery at the oasis.
